method.titleComparison: Whitespace trimming and apostrophe typography normalization only; case-insensitive exact title comparison. JetX is explicitly an alias requiring review.
method.rawHrefPolicy: demoHref retains the decoded HTML attribute as published. normalizationCandidate is a transparent mechanical correction candidate, never a claimed playable URL.
